subject: general
question:
Point A is 18 m to the east of Point B. Point B is 22 m to the north of Point C. Point D is 11 m to the west of Point C. Point E is 11 m to the south of point D. Point X is 29 m to the east of Point E.

What is the shortest distance between Point A and Point X?
solution:
Step 1: Point A is 18 m to the east of Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0557a378ad595854beb6e5d878205d32d890068d293c88ef047dd6e237b87fbf.png] 

Step 2: Point B is 22 m to the north of Point C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16f01ce1684ae774f37e58bfaf5b511ae0e218ec202c221c1837a4016b590149.png] 

Step 3: Point D is 11 m to the west of Point C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beacd86f02df61943d4314d25788012a13410d766e89d4f21117aa878c05bff7.png] 

Step 4: Point E is 11 m to the south of point D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93d004f0e8af64a5aa7dd7314bf5a3dbcaec9ea0a438b02a3d20bf9408b38624.png] 

Step 5: Point X is 29 m to the east of Point E. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22cdfcbfab507e6d213cf101cf46e96094e8f45eb47befa1abeccd45f297d302.png] 

Now the distance between Point A to Point X is same as** sum of distance between Point D to Point E & Point B to Point C.**

**DE = 11 m **and** BC = 22 m**

DE + BC => 11 m + 22 m 

**Therefore the distance between A and X is 33 m.**

**Hence, the correct answer is "33m".**
